description: Read an SPF record, a DMARC record and a set of DKIM selectors together, and report the combinations that defeat themselves. Every finding needs two or three records at once, which is why a single-record checker finds none of them: a reject policy with no usable selector, an enforcing policy over an SPF record ending in +all, strict alignment with subdomain senders, enforcement with no reporting address, and a subdomain policy that no sending path can satisfy. Pay 240000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

dkim_selectors.description: The DKIM selector records. A selector is usable only when it carries a key and is not in testing mode.

record.description: That selector record. Nothing resolves DNS: the records are supplied, which keeps the egress surface at zero and means an arbitrary domain can be audited without this service holding an allowlist for it.

dmarc.description: The DMARC record. Nothing resolves DNS: the records are supplied, which keeps the egress surface at zero and means an arbitrary domain can be audited without this service holding an allowlist for it.

domain.description: The organisational domain being audited. A trailing dot is ignored, so it does not create a second name.

sending_subdomains.description: The subdomains that send mail. Without this list nothing about subdomain senders is assessed, since there is no other way to know which exist.

items.description: A subdomain that sends mail. A trailing dot is ignored, so it does not create a second name.

spf.description: The SPF record. Omitting it is reported as nothing involving SPF having been assessed. Nothing resolves DNS: the records are supplied, which keeps the egress surface at zero and means an arbitrary domain can be audited without this service holding an allowlist for it.

name: mail_authentication_coherence_audit

coherent.description: True only when every record was supplied and no combination of them was found to defeat itself.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.
